integralPlatformSystems.justification: Glaze UI is a presentation and interaction design-system authority, not an operational administration service. The reviewed RC source creates no Manager-owned operational state and grants no administrative authority. Any future Manager registry or operational integration remains a separate downstream or production transition.

The qualified source is local-first and presentation-only, does not own privacy truth, and uses privacy-safe diagnostics. Human qualification verifies the Privacy boundaries lane. The RC does not claim Privacy Shield enforcement or production integration.

Glaze UI does not establish authentication, authorization, protection, or security truth. The qualified authority-boundary behavior fails closed and does not grant or imply security state. Stable security qualification remains a later controlled gate.

The RC is a stateless shared presentation/runtime library and does not own user data, durable application state, backup jobs, restore workflows, or preservation storage. Release rollback is explicitly to known-good Glaze UI 1.5.1; downstream products retain their own Everkeep obligations.
The V1.6 qualification matrix is complete at 24 verified / 0 unverified / 0 not applicable for the frozen qualification source.

The design-system runtime performs no service discovery, event transport, network coordination, or capability authorization. Capability and provider truth remain caller/provider-owned; the RC does not claim Mesh registration or production interoperability.

Glaze UI may present permission, restricted, unavailable, and identity-related states but does not authenticate, authorize, create sessions, or grant permissions. Human qualification verifies authority-boundary behavior.
The RC consumes supplied authoritative state for presentation and cannot create or enforce policy decisions. No automatic consequential or fallback action is granted by the presentation resolver.

V1.6 diagnostics are local-first and privacy-minimized and evaluate caller-supplied evidence; the design-system runtime does not operate a monitoring backend or claim production health. Production observability remains a downstream or deployment responsibility where applicable.
